resources.name: Standard thermochemical database for Si-C-O species

access.notes: NASA Glenn polynomial coefficients or equivalent NIST-JANAF data for SiC(s), SiO(g), CO2(g), CO(g), O2(g), O(g), SiO2(s).

resources.name: Gas-phase transport properties and boundary layer thickness

access.notes: Diffusion coefficients D_i and boundary layer thickness delta_i for O, O2, CO, CO2, SiO in CO2 carrier gas. Can be estimated from Chapman-Enskog theory and the geometry/flow of the MESOX setup (reference [11] of the paper).
